title: Elite longevity: Flacco, 41, agrees to Cincy deal

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Elite longevity: Flacco, 41, agrees to Cincy deal
sources.description: Quarterback Joe Flacco is coming back for a 19th NFL season, agreeing to a one-year, $6 million deal with the Bengals, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.
